2023       年報
           ANNUAL REPORT
       大新銀行有限公司之控股公司
       The holding company of Dah Sing Bank, Limited




    2023       年報
               ANNUAL REPORT




                                                       大新銀行扎根香港逾76年，一直堅守「以人為本」的願景。
                                                       我們不斷優化產品和服務質素，秉持以客為尊的業務宗
                                                       旨，務求信守「同步 更進步」的承諾，與客戶在香港、大灣
                                                       區以至更廣泛地區共同成長。

                                                       As a bank with over 76 years of history in Hong Kong,
                                                       Dah Sing Bank has been committed to our vision to be “the
                                                       local bank with a personal touch ”. Customer centricity
                                                       lies at the heart of everything we do, as we continually
                                                       uplift the quality of our products and services. We strive
                                                       to grow with our customers in Hong Kong, the Greater Bay
                                                       Area and beyond, delivering on our promise – “Together
                                                       We Progress and Prosper”.

    黃漢興先生
    副主席、董事總經理兼行政總裁


    黃先生，71歲，於2004年獲委任為本公司執行董事，2011年
    4 月 晉 升 為 董 事 會 副 主 席 。 彼 於 2017 年 6 月 獲 委 任 為 董 事
    總經理兼行政總裁。黃先生於1977年加入大新銀行有限公司
    服務，輾轉掌管多個部門，繼1989年成為大新銀行董事及於
    2000 年晉升為董事總經理後，至 2011 年 4 月獲委任為董事會
    副主席。彼為大新金融集團有限公司（為香港聯合交易所有限
    公司證券上市規則所界定之本公司主要股東）董事總經理兼行
    政總裁及集團內多間主要附屬公司之董事。彼於2008年6月至
    2023年8月期間出任大新銀行（中國）有限公司之董事長。彼為
    本集團擁有13.2%權益之重慶銀行股份有限公司（於香港及上
    海上市）之非執行董事及副董事長。黃先生為英國銀行學會會
    士以及香港銀行學會及英國國際零售銀行理事會創始會員。
    彼持有香港理工學院（現稱香港理工大學）商業學高級文憑及
    擁有逾45年銀行業務經驗。

Mr. Hon-Hing Wong (Derek Wong)
Vice Chairman, Managing Director and Chief Executive

Mr. Wong, aged 71, was appointed as an Executive Director
of the Company in 2004 and promoted as the Vice Chairman
in April 2011. He was appointed as the Managing Director
and Chief Executive of the Company in June 2017. Mr.
Wong joined Dah Sing Bank, Limited in 1977 and has served
and managed various departments before appointed as a
Director in 1989, promoted to the Managing Director in 2000
and then appointed as the Vice Chairman in April 2011. He
is the Managing Director and Chief Executive of Dah Sing
Financial Holdings Limited (a substantial shareholder of the
Company as defined under the Rules Governing the Listing
of Securities on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited)
and a director of various major subsidiaries of the Group. He
was the Chairman of Dah Sing Bank (China) Limited for the
period from June 2008 to August 2023. He is a Non-Executive
Director and Vice Chairman of Bank of Chongqing Co., Ltd.
(listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai) in which the Group has
a 13.2% equity interest. Mr. Wong is an Associate of The
Institute of Bankers (U.K.) and a Founder Member of The
Hong Kong Institute of Bankers and The International Retail
Banking Council of the U.K. He holds a Higher Diploma in
Business Studies from the Hong Kong Polytechnic College
(now known as Hong Kong Polytechnic University) and has
over 45 years of experience in banking.

         （流動性）規則》計算。

                                           效率及效能。內部審核部主管職能上向審核委員會交

                                       －   獨立的集團風險部職能負責監察，並向高層管理人員、

     任。本集團致力推動環境保護、企業可持續發展及提升社區參與。

ENVIRONMENT, SOCIAL AND GOVERNANCE
In addition to focusing on the strategic development of its businesses, the Group embraces its responsibilities for the
advancement of Environmental, Social and Governance (“ESG”) initiatives in the way it conducts its businesses and how it
engages its stakeholders. The Group actively strives to promote environmental protection, corporate sustainability and engage
with communities.

Sustainability considerations are embedded in our business strategy and operations. The Group strives to stay abreast of
evolving market trends and enhances the sustainability practices proactively. The Group’s ESG strategy guides its sustainability
focus and efforts in the key areas outlined below to drive continuous improvements and to create a more sustainable and
resilient future for itself as well as our society at large.

ESG Governance     — Establish ESG positioning under Board’s oversight

Governance                               Establish clear accountability on ESG oversight and strategy implementation

Communication                            Regularly communicate our ESG initiatives to our internal and external stakeholders

Reporting                                Continuously improve disclosure quality and performance tracking


Marketplace        — Prioritise Green and Sustainable Banking (“GSB”) and differentiate with small and medium enterprises
                     (“SMEs”) focus

Green and Sustainable Banking            Build capacity, raise GSB awareness and establish our green product shelves

SME Support                              Increase outreach to and assist SMEs in ESG transition

Customer Focus                           Improve customer experience and reinforce customer centricity

Digitalisation                           Optimise customer experience and operational impact through digital transformation


Workplace          — Build an engaged workforce to enhance employee loyalty

Culture and Ethical Behaviours           Promote ethical behaviours to uphold the Group’s Culture and Values

Training and Development                 Enhance organisation and leadership capabilities for future-ready workforce

Health and Well-being                    Promote health awareness and provide flexible and healthy work environment


Community          — Enrich our community strategy to enhance impact

Youth Education                          Support youth education with a focus on STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Art
                                         and Mathematics) and targeting under-privileged children

Youth Sports                             Promote sports as a means of nurturing all-round youth development

ESG Awareness                            Raise the awareness of ESG matters in the community for promoting sustainable
                                         development

Volunteering                             Engage our employees to contribute to the society through volunteering activities


Environment        — Sharpen our focus on environmental Key Performance Indicators for strategic impact and operational
                     efficiency

Environmental Footprint                  Reduce our environmental footprint and influence our supply chain

Paperless                                Reduce paper consumption through digitalising operational processes and engaging
                                         customers on digital adoption

Staff Awareness and Engagement           Promote environmental conservation to our staff for a greener planet

           際信託有限公司為家族全權信託受託人，王守業為其授予人。

2.2 綜合財務報表                 2.2 Consolidation

綜合財務報表包括本公司及其所有附屬公司截至      The consolidated financial statements include the financial statements
12月31日止之財務報表。              of the Company and all its subsidiaries made up to 31 December.


     （甲）附屬公司                    (a)   Subsidiaries

     附屬公司是本集團可控制之實體（包括結構        A subsidiary is an entity (including a structured entity) over which
     性實體）。本集團可控制該實體是指當本集        the Group has control. The Group controls an entity when the
     團透過參與該實體而面對或有權獲取可變的        Group is exposed to, or has rights to, variable returns from its
     回報，且有能力藉着對該實體之權力影響該        involvement with the entity and has the ability to affect those
     等回報。自控制權轉移予本集團當日起附屬        returns through its power over the entity. Subsidiaries are
     公司作綜合計算，並由該控制權終止之日起        consolidated from the date on which control is transferred to
     不再綜合計算。                    the Group. They are deconsolidated from the date that control
                                ceases.

      所有按攤餘成本及以公平值計量且其變動計入其      Interest income and expense are recognised in the consolidated income
      他全面收益計量之債務工具的利息收入及支出乃      statement for all debt instruments measured at amortised cost and fair
      應用實際利率法確認於綜合收益賬內。          value through other comprehensive income using the effective interest
                                 method.


      實際利率法乃是一種用以計算金融資產或金融負      The effective interest method is a method of calculating the amortised
      債之攤餘成本及其於相關期內攤分利息收入或利      cost of a financial asset or a financial liability and of allocating the
      息支出的方法。實際利率指可將金融工具在預計      interest income or interest expense over the relevant period. The
      有效期間或較短期間（如適用）內之估計未來現金     effective interest rate is the rate that exactly discounts estimated future
      收支貼現為該金融資產或金融負債之賬面淨值之      cash payments or receipts through the expected life of the financial
      適用貼現率。在計算實際利率時，本集團按金融      instrument or, when appropriate, a shorter period to the net carrying
      工具之所有合約條款（如提早清還之行使權）而估     amount of the financial asset or financial liability. When calculating the
      計其現金流量，但不考慮未發生之信貸損失。此      effective interest rate, the Group estimates cash flows considering all
      計算包括所有合約內交易雙方所收取或支付能構      contractual terms of the financial instrument (for example, prepayment
      成整體實際利息之費用及利率差價、交易成本及      options) but does not consider future credit losses. The calculation
      所有其他溢價或折讓。                 includes all fees and points paid or received between parties to
                                 the contract that are an integral part of the effective interest rate,
                                 transaction costs and all other premiums or discounts.


      若一項金融資產或一組金融資產的價值因減值虧      Once a financial asset or a group of similar financial assets has been
      損被調低，其利息收入則按計算有關減值虧損時      written down as a result of an impairment loss, interest income is
      所應用以貼現未來現金流量之利率來計量確認。      recognised using the rate of interest used to discount the future cash
                                 flows for the purpose of measuring the impairment loss.

2.25 或然負債及或然資產          2.25 Contingent liabilities and contingent assets

或然負債指因為過往事件而可能引起之承擔，而   A contingent liability is a possible obligation that arises from past events
其存在只能就集團控制範圍以外之一宗或多宗不   and whose existence will only be confirmed by the occurrence or non-
確定未來事件之出現而被確認。或然負債亦可能   occurrence of one or more uncertain future events not wholly within
是因為過往事件引致之現有承擔，但由於可能不   the control of the Group. It can also be a present obligation arising
需要有經濟資源流失，或承擔金額未能可靠衡量   from past events that is not recognised because it is not probable that
而未有記賬。                  an outflow of economic resources will be required or the amount of
                        obligation cannot be measured reliably.


或然負債不會被確認，但會在綜合財務報表附註   A contingent liability is not recognised but is disclosed in the notes to
中披露。假若資源流失之可能性改變而導致資源   the consolidated financial statements. When a change in the probability
可能流失，則被確認為撥備。           of an outflow occurs so that outflow is probable, it will then be
                        recognised as a provision.


或然資產指因為過往事件而可能產生之資產，而   A contingent asset is a possible asset that arises from past events and
其存在只能就集團控制範圍以外之一宗或多宗不   whose existence will be confirmed only by the occurrence or non-
確定事件之出現而被確認。            occurrence of one or more uncertain events not wholly within the
                        control of the Group.


或然資產不會被確認，但會於經濟收益有可能獲   A contingent asset is not recognised but is disclosed in the notes to the
得時在綜合財務報表附註中披露。若實質確定有   consolidated financial statements when an inflow of economic benefits
收益獲得時，則被確認為資產。          is probable. When such inflow is virtually certain, an asset is recognised.

      3.3 市場風險                         3.3 Market risk

      市場風險乃指由市場上利率及價格不利變化而引            Market risk is the risk of losses in assets, liabilities and off-balance sheet
      致對資產、負債及資產負債表外持倉之虧損風險。           positions arising from adverse movements in market rates and prices.


      各類交易之市場風險均由董事會、風險管理及合            Market risk exposure for different types of transactions is managed
      規委員會及財資及投資風險委員會按董事會授予            within various risk limits and guidelines approved by the Board, the
      之權力所核准之各項風險限額及指引內處理。風            RMCC and the TIRC under the authority delegated from the Board.
      險限額按組合層面以及各產品及不同風險類別設            Risk limits are set at the portfolio level as well as by products and
      定。該等限額綜合包含了名義金額、止蝕限額、            by different types of risks. The risk limits comprise a combination
      敏感性及運用市場風險數值（「市場風險數值」）之          of notional, stop-loss, sensitivity and value-at-risk ( “VaR”) controls.
      監控。所有涉及市場風險的交易持倉需要每日按            All trading positions are subject to daily mark-to-market valuation.
      市值入賬。集團風險部之風險管理及監控部（「風           The Risk Management and Control Department (“RMCD”) within the
      險管理及監控部」）乃一個獨立之風險管理及控制           GRD, as an independent risk management and control unit, identifies,
      部門，負責比較風險和已審批限額，以識別、計            measures, monitors and controls the risk exposures against approved
      量、監控及管理該等風險及提議具體行動去確保            limits and initiates specific actions to ensure positions are managed
      持倉被限制在可接受水平內。任何不符合限額情            within an acceptable level. Any exceptions have to be reviewed and
      況均須依據有關政策及程序經合適管理層－財資            sanctioned by the appropriate level of management of TIRC, RMCC or
      及投資風險委員會，風險管理及合規委員會或董            the Board as stipulated in the relevant policies and procedures.
      事會審查及批准。


      大新銀行之附屬公司澳門商業銀行股份有限公司            Banco Comercial de Macau, S.A. (“BCM”) and Dah Sing Bank (China)

3.3.1 源自交易賬之市場風險            3.3.1 Market risk arising from the trading book

本集團之交易賬內，在外匯、債務證券、權益性       In the Group’s trading book, market risk is associated with trading
證券及衍生工具之交易持倉中存在市場風險。        positions in foreign exchange, debt securities, equity securities and
                            derivatives.


     （甲） 市場風險計量方法                 (a)      Market risk measurement technique

     作為市場風險管理，本集團使用各種業界普          In the management of market risk, the Group measures market
     遍採用之方法計量市場風險及控制市場風險          risks using various techniques commonly used by the industry
     於設定之風險額度範圍內。主要用於計量及          and control market risk exposures within established risk limits.
     監控市場風險之計量方法概述如下。             The major measurement techniques used to measure and control
                                  market risk are outlined below.


        (i)   市場風險數值                       (i)   Value-at-risk

        本集團應用市場風險數值法，其乃一                   The Group applies a VaR methodology, which is a
        種以統計為基準就持作交易用途組合                   statistically based estimate, to measure the potential loss
        因市場不利變化預計潛在損失。其表                   of its trading portfolio from adverse market movements. It
        明本集團於某個置信水平可能損失之                   expresses as the maximum amount the Group might lose
        最大數額，就一日持倉期之基準作推                   given a certain level of confidence, which for the Group
        算，本集團之置信水平為99%。因此                  is 99% for a one day holding period. There is therefore a
        存在明確的統計概率，實際損失可能                   specified statistical probability that actual loss could be
        比市場風險數值之估計數為大。因此                   greater than the VaR estimate. Hence, the use of VaR does
        採納該方法並不能避免當市場狀況發                   not prevent losses outside the VaR limits in the event of
        生重大變化時超逾此等額度之損失。                   extreme market movements.


        市場風險數值模型假設某個持倉期                    The VaR model assumes a certain “holding period” (one
       （就本集團而言為一天）直至結束持                    day in the case of the Group) until positions can be closed.
        倉。市場風險數值亦依據持倉之現時                   It is calculated based on the current mark-to-market value
        市值、市場風險因素過往在一個曆年                   of the positions, the historical correlation and volatilities
        週期之相互關係及波幅，使用一種歷                   of the market risk factors over an observation period of

      6.   營業分項報告                6.    OPERATING SEGMENT REPORTING
      本集團根據香港財務報告準則第 8 號《營運業務分   Segment reporting by the Group is prepared in accordance with HKFRS
      項》編製分項報告。向包括行政總裁及其他執行委     8 “Operating Segments”. Information reported to the chief operating
      員會成員之主要營運決策人呈報而作為資源分配      decision maker, including the Chief Executive and other EC members,
      及業績評估用途之資料，乃按個人銀行、企業銀      for the purposes of resource allocation and performance assessment,
      行、財資及環球市場及中國內地及澳門銀行業務      is determined on the basis of personal banking, corporate banking,
      分類之基礎來確定。本地銀行業務之營運表現按      treasury and global markets and banking businesses in Mainland China
      業務活動分析，而中國內地及澳門銀行業務之營      and Macau. Operating performances are analysed by business activities
      運表現按業務機構分析。                for local banking business, and on business entity basis for banking
                                 businesses in Mainland China and Macau.


      經考慮到本地業務之客戶群、產品及服務，經濟      Considering the customer groups, products and services of local
      環境和法規後，本集團將營運業務劃分為下列呈      businesses, the economic environment and regulations, the Group
      報分項：                       splits the operating segments of the Group into the following reportable
                                 segments:


      •    個人銀行業務包括接受個人客戶存款、住宅   •     Personal banking business includes the acceptance of deposits
           樓宇按揭、私人貸款、透支、汽車貸款和信         from individual customers and the extension of residential
           用卡服務、保險業務的銷售和投資服務。          mortgage lending, personal loans, overdraft, vehicle financing
                                       and credit card services, and the provision of insurance sales and
                                       investment services.


      •    企業銀行業務包括接受存款、貸款、營運資   •     Corporate banking business includes the acceptance of deposits
           金融資及貿易融資，其存款來源及融資客戶         from and the advance of loans and working capital finance to
           主要是工商業及機構性客戶。               commercial, industrial and institutional customers, and the
                                       provision of trade financing.


      •    財資及環球市場業務主要包括外匯服務、中   •     Treasury and global markets activities are mainly the provision
           央貸存現金管理、利率風險管理、證券投資         of foreign exchange services and centralised cash management
           管理及本集團整體之資金運用管理。            for deposit taking and lending, interest rate risk management,
                                       management of investment in securities and the overall funding
                                       of the Group.


      •    中國內地及澳門銀行業務包括由位於中國內   •     Mainland China and Macau banking businesses include personal
           地和澳門之附屬公司提供之個人銀行和企業         banking, corporate banking business activities provided by
           銀行業務及本集團一間在中國內地設立之商         subsidiaries in Mainland China and Macau, and the Group ’ s
           業銀行之權益。                     interest in a commercial bank in Mainland China.


      •    其他包括未可直接歸類於其他呈報分項之營   •     Others include results of operations not directly identified under
           運業績、集團投資及債務資金（包括後償債         other reportable segments, corporate investments and debt
           務）。                         funding (including subordinated notes).

就編製分項報告而言，對可直接認明為各個別分   For the purpose of segment reporting, revenue derived from customers,
項之源自客戶、產品及服務收入，將直接呈報於   products and services directly identifiable with individual segments
有關分項；而分項之間的資金運用及資金資源所   are reported directly under respective segments, while revenue
產生的收入和資金成本，按參照市場利率之轉移   and funding cost arising from inter-segment funding operation and
價格機制分配至各分項。分項間之交易乃依據授   funding resources are allocated to segments by way of transfer pricing
予第三者或與第三者交易之同類條款定價。分項   mechanism with reference to market interest rates. Transactions within
間之收入或支出於綜合賬內抵銷。         segments are priced based on similar terms offered to or transacted
                        with external parties. Inter-segment income or expenses are eliminated
                        on consolidation.


所有不同分項之直接開支將歸類於有關的分項分   All direct costs incurred by different segments are grouped under
類。間接開支及支援部門開支乃依據開支性質，   respective segments. Indirect costs and support functions’ costs are
按耗用之時間及工作量和分項營運收入，分配至   allocated to various segments and products based on effort and time
不同的分項及產品。不能合理地分配至各分項、   spent as well as segments’ operating income depending on the nature
產品及支援部門之企業活動開支，則作企業開支   of costs incurred. Costs related to corporate activities that cannot be
呈列於「其他」項下。              reasonably allocated to segments, products and support functions are
                        grouped under Others as unallocated corporate expenses.

（乙）投資之減值測試及於 2023 年確認之減     (b) Impairment testing on the investment and impairment
   值                            recognised in 2023

於2023年12月31日，本集團在重慶銀行之投資之   At 31 December 2023, the fair value of the Group’s investment in BOCQ
公平值已低於賬面值大約 10 年。為此，本集團持    had been below the carrying amount for approximately 10 years. On
續對在重慶銀行之投資之賬面值進行減值測試以       this basis, the Group continues to perform an impairment test on the
評估可收回金額。                    carrying amount of the investment in BOCQ to assess the recoverable
                            amount.


減值測試比對以計算使用價值（「使用價值」）而釐     The impairment test is performed by comparing the recoverable
定之重慶銀行可收回金額和該投資之賬面值。使       amount of BOCQ, determined by a value in use ( “VIU”) calculation,
用價值乃按照管理層估量之重慶銀行盈利和未來       with the carrying amount of the investment. The VIU calculation uses
將派股息，及經考慮重慶銀行中期和長期之增長       discounted cash flow projections based on management’s estimates of
及資產淨值後之預期未來的可能脫手價值，應用       BOCQ’s earnings and dividends to be paid in future, and the estimated
貼現現金流量預測計算。應用於使用價值計算之       probable exit value in future after considering the growth of BOCQ and
貼現率乃參考可於公開市場獲取之重慶銀行股本       its net asset value for the medium and longer term. The discount rate
成本而估算。                      applied to the VIU calculation was estimated with reference to BOCQ’s
                            cost of equity, which is publicly available in the market.


進行使用價值計算以得出該投資之可收回金額        In performing the VIU calculation to arrive at the recoverable amount
時，本集團考慮所有相關因素包括市場觀點及質       of the investment, the Group considers all relevant factors including
化因素以確保計算使用價值之參數合適。調整亦       market views and qualitative factors to ensure that the inputs to the
須作出以反映影響重慶銀行之最新情況及對預測       VIU calculation are appropriate. Adjustments need to be made to
重慶銀行未來表現有關之中期及長期市場展望。       reflect the latest situation affecting BOCQ and also market outlook for
在估算重慶銀行之未來現金流當中需要管理層作       the medium and longer term that are relevant in projecting BOCQ ’s
重要判斷。                       future performance. Significant management judgement is required in
                            estimating the future cash flows of BOCQ.

有關連人士為該等人士有能力直接或間接控制另           Related parties are those parties, which have the ability, directly or
一方，或對另一方在作出財務及營運決策方面行           indirectly, to control the other party or exercise significant influence
使重大影響力。倘若其他不同人士受到共同控制           over the other party in making financial and operating decisions.
或共同重大影響時，彼等人士亦被視為有關連人           Parties are also considered to be related if they are subject to common
士。                              control or common significant influence.

公司進行多項持續關連交易。本公司獨立非執行           indirectly controlled or significantly influenced by the shareholders or
董事在檢閱本集團之綜合財務報表時，已對該等           directors of the holding company. These, as described in Note (a) below
如下列註（甲）敍述及屬於持續有關連之交易進行          and being continuing connected transactions, had been reviewed by the
審閱。該等董事根據其檢閱及根據向管理層之詢           Company’s independent non-executive directors in their review of the
問，認為全部持續有關連之交易乃根據本集團之           consolidated financial statements of the Group. Based on their review

公平且合理及符合本公司股東整體利益進行。            executive directors were satisfied that all of the continuing connected

      總體淨額結算安排                    Master netting arrangements

      本集團會盡可能與交易對手訂立總體淨額結算安       To mitigate credit risks, the Group enters into master netting
      排，以減低信貸風險。淨額結算協議規定，一旦       arrangements with counterparties whenever possible. Netting
      出現違約事件，所有涉及交易對手之未完成交易       agreements provide that, if an event of default occurs, all outstanding
      均會終止，而所有結欠款項將拼合按淨額結算。       transactions with the counterparty will be terminated and all amounts
      如非發生違約事件，所有與對手之交易會以總額       outstanding will be settled on a net basis. Except for the event of
      結算及一般不會在綜合財務狀況表中對銷資產及       default, all outstanding transactions with the counterparty are settled
      負債。                         on a gross basis and generally do not result in offsetting the assets and
                                  liabilities in the consolidated statement of financial position.
